title: Begin with God's love
content:
Pause and remember that you are loved by God.

Name one way you have received care this week, and thank Him for it.
plan_description: Three days of reflection on God's love, trust, and gratitude.

title: Trust the next step
content: Bring one decision to God in prayer. Choose a faithful step you can take today.

title: Practice gratitude
content: Notice three gifts in your day. Write them down and encourage someone who needs hope.

title: Make room to listen
content: Set aside a quiet moment. Bring your concerns to God, then listen without rushing to the next task.
plan_description: Two days of learning to pray with honesty and care for others.

title: Pray for someone
content: Choose someone who needs support. Pray for them by name, then offer a practical act of kindness.
